findings.summary: Lag and rolling features (shift(1), shift(7), rolling(7)) are computed over the whole frame without grouping by store_id, so they mix data across stores, and only the first 7 rows overall are dropped instead of the first week per store.
test_lag_features uses a single-store frame, so it passes despite the ungrouped shift bug; it needs a multi-store frame in (date, store_id) order.
